awkl=$(mktemp)
cat > "$awkl" <<'AWK'
function flush(   i,k) {
  if (nadd > nrem) {
    ng++
    gctx[ng] = hasctx ? ctx : ""

NR == FNR {
  if (indiff == 0) {
    if ($0 ~ /^@@/) { indiff = 1; flush() }
    next

  if ($0 ~ /^\\/) next
  if ($0 ~ /^@@/) { flush(); next }
  if ($0 ~ /^-/) { if (nadd > 0) flush(); rem[++nrem] = substr($0, 2); next }
  if ($0 ~ /^\+/) { s = substr($0, 2); add[++nadd] = s; adset[s] = 1; next }
  if ($0 ~ /^ /) { flush(); ctx = substr($0, 2); hasctx = 1; next }
  next

{ line[++ln] = $0 }
END {
  flush()
  m = 0
  for (i = 1; i <= ln; i++) {
    l = line[i]
    if ((l in rmset) && !(l in adset)) continue
    keep[++m] = l
  }
  idx = 0
  outn = 0
  for (g = 1; g <= ng; g++) {

    idx = pos
    for (k = 1; k <= gn[g]; k++) {
      l = gl[g,k]
      present = 0

empty=$(git hash-object -w -t blob /dev/null)
conf=$(mktemp)
git diff --name-only --diff-filter=U -z > "$conf"
while IFS= read -r -d '' f; do

  ours=$(git rev-parse -q --verify ":2:$f") || ours=""
  theirs=$(git rev-parse -q --verify ":3:$f") || theirs=""

      awk -f "$awkl" "$d" "$f" > "$t"
      cat "$t" > "$f"
      rm -f "$t"
    fi
    rm -f "$d"
  fi
  git add -- "$f"

git add -A
